title: Account
intro: Your details are shared with a stall only on the orders you place there.

sell.title: Sell at MarketLink
sell.text: If you grow food, this account can become a stall. You keep your orders, favorites and cart, and a panel appears for stock and pickup times once an admin approves you.

status.pending: Your application is with an admin. Nothing changes for you until they answer.
status.approved: Your stall is approved. Set markets, pickup windows and products in the farmer panel.
status.rejected: Your application was not approved. Open it to see what was sent.
status.suspended: Your stall is suspended. You can still shop as a customer.

signOut.title: Sign out
signOut.text: Signs you out on this device only.

profile.title: Your details
profile.loadFailed: Could not load your details. Please try again.

signedOut.title: You are signed out.
signedOut.text: Sign in again to see and edit your details.

profile.emailHint: Used to sign in. It cannot be changed here.
profile.saveFailed: Could not save your details. Please try again.

password.rowNote: The password you sign in with by email.
password.title: Change password
password.intro: You will be signed out on every device and asked to sign in again.
password.changed: Your password has been changed. Please sign in again.
password.failed: Could not change your password. Please try again.

errors.same: Use a password different from the current one.

photo.title: Profile photo
photo.intro: Shown in the menu and to stalls on your orders. JPEG, PNG or a photo from your camera.

photoErrors.notPhoto: Choose a photo (JPEG, PNG, HEIC or WebP).
photoErrors.tooBig: That photo is over {{mb}} MB. Choose a smaller one.
photoErrors.unreadable: This file is not a photo we can read.
photoErrors.noPicture: The camera has no picture yet. Try again.

dialog.frameHelp: Drag to move the photo and zoom until your face fills the circle.
dialog.saveFailed: Could not save your photo. Please try again.
dialog.takeFailed: Could not take the photo. Try again.

blocked.title: Camera access is blocked.
blocked.text: Allow the camera for this site in your browser settings, or upload a photo instead.

notFound.title: No camera was found.
notFound.text: Plug one in, or upload a photo instead.

busy.title: The camera is busy.
busy.text: Close other apps using it and try again, or upload a photo.

failed.title: The camera could not start.
failed.text: Try again, or upload a photo instead.

insecure.title: This browser cannot open the camera here.
insecure.text: The camera needs a secure (https) page. Upload a photo instead.

crop.frame: Photo framing. Drag, or use the arrow keys to move it and plus or minus to zoom.

achievements.title: Your achievements
achievements.intro: Counted from the orders you collected at the stalls. Only you see these figures.
achievements.rateNeeded: You also need a completion rate of at least {{rate}}%. Orders the stall declined never count against you.
achievements.top: You are at the top tier. Thank you for shopping at the market.

perks.diamond: Shimmering diamond frame with a gem

unavailable.title: No order figures yet
unavailable.text: Your tier and figures fill in by themselves once your orders are recorded.

achievements.privacy: Stalls and other shoppers see your tier next to your name, never these figures.

hero.line_one: {{name}}, you have collected {{count}} order and spent {{amount}} at the market.
hero.line_other: {{name}}, you have collected {{count}} orders and spent {{amount}} at the market.
hero.welcome: Welcome to the market, {{name}}. Collect your first orders to climb the tiers.

bronze: A bronze frame around your photo, in the menu and on your profile
Your tier next to your name on reviews and in messages
silver: A thicker silver frame around your photo
Stalls see Silver tier next to your name on orders and in messages
Your reviews carry the Silver tier badge
gold: A gold frame with a star at the corner of your photo
Stalls see Gold tier next to your name on orders and in messages
Your reviews carry the Gold tier badge
diamond: A shimmering diamond frame with a gem at the corner of your photo
Stalls see Diamond tier next to your name on orders and in messages
Your reviews carry the Diamond tier badge
A sparkling membership card on your profile
